submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation studies, Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at a threshold of 36 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.0% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This significantly outperforms Algorithm-L3 (84.6% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L2 (74.2% at 30 GeV). The algorithm is confirmed to fit within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs) per the candidate specifications, making it deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware. The 36 GeV threshold is within the allowed 20-60 GeV range and represents the optimal operating point that maximizes signal efficiency while respecting the rate allocation.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 36 GeV achieves 93.0% signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocated rate, which is the highest among all tested configurations (Algorithm-L3 best: 84.6%, Algorithm-L2 best: 74.2%)

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
